pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/nights.rs:82 The multi-night harness discards the forced sleep cycle's Result and NightsReport has no per-pass outcome field, while the cycle record sits in a temp memory dir deleted after the last night unless keep_memory is set, so a night two that ran on a failed consolidation is indistinguishable from one that ran on a good one.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/nights.rs:82 The technique requires a completion rate per pass reported beside quality, and an instrument honest about its own failure. brain.last_consolidation() exposes the Result (already consulted at line 80) but no outcome reaches NightRow or NightsReport. Scope: on-show moments are written deterministically without the sleep cycle (brain moments.rs:3-5), so shown/used are not zeroed by this; what goes unreported is whether the consolidated facts and habits that night two ran on exist.

crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/runner.rs:1136 Runs exercise the real Brain (build_brain) against a per-run temp store removed at runner.rs:1153-1154, so recall write-back cannot reach a production ranking. Sharing across nights is the behaviour under simulation, inside one throwaway store.

crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/nights.rs:14 Conformant only through the technique's 'when not to use it' branch: there is no task set with checkable memory answers, so it instruments whether recalled items were acted on and claims no worth. No no-memory arm exists (case-insensitive search for baseline and no-memory variants in src found none), so the pipeline's value stays unmeasured here.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/nights.rs:192 Used is counted per moment from content evidence in the host's lines, separate from shown, and nothing flows back into the store as credit.

crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/nights.rs:65 Harness half only: message instants and the consolidation time are supplied on the multi-night clock rather than read from the process. Whether the distiller prompt grounds against them lives in the brain and was not judged here.

crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/nights.rs:186 The sim only reads the store directly; a search of the crate for MemoryStore and store write calls found open and this fact read, so it adds no second belief writer and has no lane to govern.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/judge.rs:265 Consumer of the directive store only, and this read filters correctly. The store's shape belongs to the reconcile crate, not this context.
